# v0.10.2 - More Fixes from the c305b0a Review Round, and Two More Deprecation Warnings

## What's Changed in v0.10.2

A fixes-only release (maintenance mode): thirteen defects from the open list of the c305b0a review round, none of them a loss of what a vault holds, each with a test that fails without it (the long-path time is simulated). It also continues the deprecation policy's warning pass.

### Fixed
- **Snapshots**: a tracked file replaced by a repository with no commit no longer stops every later run; a file renamed by the case of a non-ASCII letter (`Über.txt` to `über.txt` on NTFS or APFS) is no longer kept under both names; `--default-excludes` keeps what a repository embedded in the source repository has committed under a recommended name (`node_modules`); a vault that takes over ten minutes to download can be joined, and a large embedded repository can be captured (both now have the no-progress watchdog instead of the plain 600 s clock).
- **Restore**: a payload name that differs only by case from a file git checked out is no longer reported verified; a payload restore onto a FAT or exFAT volume mounted on Linux or macOS skips and names a file the volume cannot hold (a trailing dot, a colon) instead of reporting it verified or failing after the download (measured on a vfat mount); a recorded file time under a folder past 260 characters is applied.
- **`--payload-view`** no longer loses a file named by its own hash when another file in the folder has the same bytes.
- **`--maintain --vault <vault>`** runs from any directory; it never touched the source, but refused any vault that remembers another one.
- **Two snapshots started together** over one stale lock can no longer both take it (POSIX).

### Deprecated
- **`--payload-view`, `--payload-gc` and `--payload-verify` now print a `Warning:`** for the snapshot options they accept and never read, and refuse them from 0.11, as the options of 0.10.1. A job with `--exit-warnings` that passes one exits `3` until it is dropped. See "Options by mode" in `SNAPSHOT.md`.

### Upgrading

Nothing about what is stored changes and no setting is renamed. See "Upgrading to v0.10.2" in `UPGRADING.md`.

The full list is in `CHANGELOG.md`.
